Name: Frog to Rat Companion
Author: SkullCameo
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nj7u0As.png[/img]

Ever looked at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21031]Slumberwood's Rats[/url] and thought "Hey, those are cute! I wish they could follow me everywhere!" Well, good news! Now they can!
These hungry rat companions will accompany you on the most dangerous of adventures if you offer them a [s]Scooby Snack[/s] tasty biscuit baked just for them.
Like most rats, they won't hesitate to pass up free food and will use their odd, frog-like tongues to eat any monsters that come too close. (I recommend using[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26144] Better Frog Control[/url] if you don't want to witness that, I don't blame you.)

Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/slumberwood?gameId=1303]Slumberwood [/url]for letting me genetically alter their rats! I had to make them dwarf rats to fit the bounds of the trinkets.
Thanks to the SDV modding discord for helping me figure out how to change the right strings to rename things.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vu8IgGw.gif[/img]
Bug reports and edit suggestions welcome. Make sure you get the rat coop animals from [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/slumberwood/about-me]Slumberwood![/url]﻿ They make Junimo squeaks!
